company.name: Rebolt
company.shortDescription: Creating transparency and accountability on companies' commitments to social impact causes
company.description: Millennials and generation Z, now more than ever, are interested in companies invested in social impact, fairness in compensation, and development of their employees. Younger generations find themselves in positions of less power and, as such, exercise their authority through their choice of employer, thus creating a need for employers to invest in transparency regarding their performance in these areas. Rebolt is a total market solution. It is a tool providing analytics and transparency to the public regarding companies' investments and performance in critical metrics regarding social impact investment, workplace fairness and accountability, and employee development and satisfaction. It is also B2B solution utilizing algorithmic-based compensation methods to ensure clarity and equality in criterion and fairness of outcome.
